# Shared setup for the five decks + cheat sheet (labs carry their own inline copy so each lab stays a standalone script).
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(sf); library(spdep); library(spatialreg); library(smerc); library(patchwork) })
sf_use_s2(FALSE)                                   # planar geometry: simple and fast for a small synthetic district
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 16))
geo_path <- c("data/gis/district_blocks.geojson", "../data/gis/district_blocks.geojson", "../../data/gis/district_blocks.geojson")
geo_path <- geo_path[file.exists(geo_path)][1]
fac_path <- sub("district_blocks.geojson", "facilities.csv", geo_path, fixed = TRUE)
blocks <- st_read(geo_path, quiet = TRUE)
blocks$high_burden <- factor(blocks$high_burden, levels = c("Not high", "High"))
nb <- poly2nb(blocks, queen = TRUE, snap = 1e-4)
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
col_blue <- "#3498db"; col_red <- "#e74c3c"; col_navy <- "#2c3e50"; col_green <- "#27ae60"

chunks.code:
ols <- lm(dengue_per_100k ~ poverty_index + literacy_pct, data = blocks)
round(summary(ols)$coefficients, 3)

blocks$res_ols <- residuals(ols)
ggplot(blocks) + geom_sf(aes(fill = res_ols)) + scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b", name = "Residual") +
  labs(title = "OLS residuals: neighbours share the same sign")
lm.RStests(ols, lw, test = c("RSerr", "RSlag", "adjRSerr", "adjRSlag"), zero.policy = TRUE)

sem <- errorsarlm(dengue_per_100k ~ poverty_index + literacy_pct, data = blocks, listw = lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
sar <- lagsarlm(dengue_per_100k ~ poverty_index + literacy_pct, data = blocks, listw = lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
c(lambda = sem$lambda, rho = sar$rho) |> round(3)
AIC(ols, sem, sar)
c(OLS = unname(moran.test(residuals(ols), lw, zero.policy = TRUE)$estimate[1]), SEM = unname(moran.test(residuals(sem), lw, zero.policy = TRUE)$estimate[1])) |> round(3)

set.seed(6)
summary(impacts(sar, listw = lw, R = 199), zstats = TRUE, short = TRUE)
